title: Handling and ride impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise the G70's handling, often alongside ride quality, while many other fragments mention handling without enough context to confirm sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe handling as great, excellent, very good, balanced, and among the best-driving experiences, sometimes paired with strong ride comfort.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention handling or describe it briefly, but the limited wording makes the sentiment assignment unclear in the supplied examples.

limitations: The sampled undetermined examples are too brief or context-limited to explain why they were not assigned a clearer sentiment.
Examples are heavily concentrated on handling praise, so other possible handling-related nuances may be missing from the sample.
This topic overlaps handling and ride comments, so some fragments reflect both aspects rather than handling alone.
